== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34628) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Tashima LS WHAP.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 28 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>de2775709bcc615db2a8fb9bb2b4f9d7cb221027b20090b881d6fa9f3d9baebb</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
* 1x [[Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>221_70</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Qui-Gon Jinn’s Lightsaber (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
